notes.title: Strategic Command Classic: WWI is OUT!
notes.content:
A great classic game returns, as [b]Strategic Command Classic: WWI[/b] [b]is available![/b]

This release will also include the expansion [b]"Strategic Command WWI - Breakthrough!"[/b], Introducing the armoured train unit. You'll find all the nice combat features from the Battlefront version like combat unit swapping, improved bombardment options, and so on.  The expansion Breakthrough is also included adding by default a variety of additional scenarios and a range of modding features to the game editor.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=THZcQbSX-bI

[b]IMPORTANT![/b]

[i]This is not a new game. We are taking over from Battlefront as the publisher of this game. If you already bought the game from Battlefront please read this carefully as we don't want you to accidentally buy something you might be getting for free! [/i]

[url=http://www.matrixgames.com/forums/tm.asp?m=4389357]Read here the full story and what you need to do[/url]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/388140/Strategic_Command_Classic_WWI/
